definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (4.173) 'finishing with an end marker or the end of the compilation group, including any contained source units' puts contained units inside the definition; §2023:3.165 says the same in Note 1. The containment test for PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE is the same. The scope and the evidence do not change.

definition-dropped.answer: The screen matched 'initial program' inside 'the initial program collating sequences' (§2002:12.2.5.3 GR10). There 'initial' qualifies the program collating sequences. It is not the term defined in §2002:4 (4.106 'A program that is placed into the initial state every time the program is called'), so that definition has no bearing on the rule.
